_note: MACHINE-READABLE config only. Current status + per-environment state + the history of every add/remove/migrate: .claude/environments/environments_setup.md. How to set one up or retire one: .claude/SETUP.md. Neither copies the values below — this file wins on any disagreement. The environment inventory + schedule ownership (Hector 2026-07-19): scheduleOwner names the ONE environment allowed to run scheduled jobs; every environment identifies itself via the WS_ENV env var (enforcement + migration mechanics: SYSTEM.md 'Scheduled tasks' — not restated here). Non-sensitive instance config lives here too (2026-07-20: no code defaults for identity/instance values — sensitive ones are required env vars, see .env.example).
_ceo_note: WHO THE SYSTEM WORKS FOR. The one place the operator's name is written; cli/util/ceo.js is the single read path, used for the CEO block pinned on held test-plans, the 'is this case waiting on a human' test, and the orchestrator prompts. Change it here and the whole system addresses someone else — nothing in code hardcodes a name (CLAUDE.md's invariant: a fresh clone must already be a working system for ITS operator). NOT the place for the CEO's email: OWNER_EMAIL / AGENT_EMAIL own that fact in env (.env.example) and the mail path reads them directly — nothing here needs an address, nothing there needs a name. Unset name degrades to the generic label 'the CEO', never to a guess. NAMING lives here too (the CEO, 2026-08-15): `hubTitle` is the operator's chosen name for the hub web page, served to the hub app via the log API `GET /identity` (server/README.md) — unset degrades to 'Hub'.

external_skills_git._note: Canonical upstream sources for external agent skills (plan skills-integration-migration, backlog item 41). Agents install/update skills ONLY from these repos — no substitute sources; a missing repo/path is a blocked line, not an improvisation. Vendored copies live in .claude/skills/<name>/.
